verdict.rationale: Undermind's docs describe an autonomous deep literature review that starts from an open-ended goal. It plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers, then produces a ranked synthesis. Community reports of multi-minute searches, clarifying follow-up questions and an exhaustiveness progress metric corroborate the multi-step design. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the investigation's intermediate steps or plan trace, and independent evidence that refined searches reliably explore new directions (one user saw near-identical results on a second search).

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis. Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
The 'Discovery Progress and Exhaustiveness' section (e.g., 23.6% of relevant papers found)
